cohort: Pregnant women who delivered at the University Hospital "G. Martino" in Messina, Italy, between January 1, 2010, and December 31, 2016.
finding: Several factors, including a history of preterm delivery, maternal marital status and BMI, uterine anomalies, infections, amniotic fluid abnormalities, maternal diabetes, hypertension, and short cervical length, were significantly associated with preterm birth.
